description: inspect schema takes --source like vet schema: the schema's own $parts/*.kdl import resolves against --source parts=parts, so the import item is followed by each matched document in portable-path-byte order, $parts/a.kdl (source 1, contributing the Extra type) then $parts/b.kdl (source 2, contributing the extra node), each shown under the source's name, before the importing document's remaining items; the inputs are this scenario's own copies of schemas/vet/import-source-pattern
